title: Promote secondary frames into bounded subplans
description: Split CPT and Integrations frames into future subplans after the Filter Preset slice is stable.
objective: Keep frames 01-15 useful without bloating the first implementation pass.
acceptance_criteria: Each subplan has scope boundary, entry condition, exit condition, and max depth.
Runtime adapter work remains explicitly forbidden unless separately approved.
Subplans do not depend on re-reading the whole legacy frame plan.
verification: MCP export after subplans are added.
Expanded SUBPLAN-CPT-MANAGER with frame 11 through 15 tasks and tests.
Expanded SUBPLAN-INTEGRATIONS-DOSSIER with child subplan routing.
Created bounded subplans for Connector Registry, QA Scenario Runner, Editor Handoff Notes, Design Token Mapper, and remaining integration module backlog.
Validated all TASK-010 subplans with mcp__agentic_ops__.validate_subplan.
Kept all runtime adapter work explicitly forbidden or deferred.

budgets.time_budget: one planning pass after first slice

risks: Secondary modules can accidentally turn into runtime product scope.
Design Token Mapper can drift into a full design-system builder.
